dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.setupProfile: Fill in your profile with your personal data
dashboard.setupFirst: Send your first removal requests to data brokers
dashboard.nothingToDo: Nothing to do. All requests are in progress.
dashboard.unmatchedMails: {count} mail(s) in the inbox waiting to be assigned

brokers.title: Data brokers
brokers.intro: Select companies and create requests. The curated list comes from public privacy policies (as of Oct 2026) and should be double-checked before sending.
brokers.name: Name
brokers.dataUrls: Where your data appears (URLs, one per line)
brokers.dataUrlsHint: These links are inserted into the request.
brokers.newIntro: For any website or company that shows your data. The app searches the website for a privacy contact address.
brokers.curatedReadonly: Curated entries cannot be edited. Create your own copy to adjust contact details.
brokers.deleteBrokerHint: Also deletes all requests to this entry.
brokers.channelFormHint: This broker only processes requests through its web form or portal.

requests.title: Requests
requests.empty: No requests yet. Select companies under “Data brokers”.
requests.subject: Subject
requests.autoRemind: Remind automatically when the deadline passes
requests.escalationIntro: The deadline has passed and the reminder was unsuccessful. You can now file a complaint with the supervisory authority.
requests.idWarning: This recipient usually requires proof of identity. Expect a follow-up question.
requests.nextStepsIntro: The recipient replied and asks you to do something. Complete the items below, then mark the action as done.
requests.nextStepsUnknown: The reply could not be classified automatically. Read it in the thread and set the status yourself.
requests.replyIntro: The reply is sent in the same e-mail thread to the recipient.
requests.bouncedIntro: The address does not exist or rejects external senders. Check the broker entry, correct the recipient address below and send again, or use the broker's form.
requests.brokerHasNewEmail: The broker entry now has a different address: {email}. It is already filled in below.
requests.formOnlyHint: This broker usually accepts requests only through its form:
requests.formIntro: This broker only processes requests through its web form. Open the form, paste your data (copy button) and then mark “Form submitted”. The deadline starts and replies are tracked.

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: These details are inserted into requests so recipients can find your records. Provide only what is necessary.
profile.aliasesHint: Former names, spelling variants, maiden name. One per line.
profile.addressesHint: Your current address and previous addresses that data brokers may have on file.
profile.legacyAddresses: These addresses come from the old free-text field. Please re-enter them below in structured form so they are used in requests.

mail.title: Mail account
mail.intro: Requests are sent through your own mailbox. Replies are read via IMAP and matched to requests automatically (reference in the subject). Passwords are stored encrypted.
mail.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mail.imapSameCreds: Leave empty to reuse the SMTP credentials.
mail.hint: Tip: use a dedicated address such as privacy@yourdomain.com so replies arrive in one place. For Gmail use an app password; for Proton use Proton Bridge.
mail.sentMailboxHint: Every sent request, reminder and reply is also copied via IMAP into this folder so it shows up under “Sent” in your mail client. Leave empty for auto-detection.
mail.automationIntro: What the app does without you. Every automatic action appears in the request timeline.
mail.autoFollowupHint: When a broker asks for proof of identity or additional details (without insisting on a form), the app sends the matching reply template once, in the same thread.
mail.autoConfirmLinksHint: When a reply contains a “please confirm your request” link, the app opens it server-side and records the page's response.
mail.autoResendHint: When a mail bounces and the broker entry meanwhile has a different address, the request is resent there (max. 2 times). If the broker is now “form only”, the request becomes a form task.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: System templates for GDPR, Swiss FADP and CCPA. You can override any template for yourself. Placeholders in double curly braces are replaced when a request is created.
templates.subject: Subject

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.intro: All replies from your mailbox. Automatically matched mails go straight to their request; assign the rest here with one click. The app remembers the sender for next time.
inbox.empty_open: No open mails. Everything is matched.
inbox.learnHint: Future mails from this address/domain are matched to this broker automatically.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: Complete log: every send, every reply, every automatic action with a timestamp.

events.request_form_only: Form task created (broker does not accept e-mail)
events.auto_confirm_failed: Confirmation link could not be confirmed
